data.content_ref: inline:Meet-of-schools skeptical fixpoint: when multiple school policies coexist (SRC_001-style), define the global semantics as the meet (pointwise intersection) of school-local grounded extensions. Claim: (a) the meet is itself a grounded extension of a derived framework iff the local operators are monotone and the policies form a chain under skepticism; (b) determinism is preserved, cost is polynomial in the number of schools; (c) the meet is strictly more skeptical than any single school, so committed roots remain valid for every school. This extends SRC_006's 'two genuinely different school families' to an arbitrary finite family and asks whether the meet, not any union, is the right multi-stakeholder semantics.
